verdict.rationale: v0's own docs say Projects connect to database integrations (Neon Serverless Postgres, Upstash Redis, Supabase). They also say v0 "connects to databases as it builds", with "automatic integration, no accounts required" and shared project environment variables, which together describe in-builder database setup and wiring. Missing for 10: step-by-step first-party docs of the provisioning flow and of how credentials are injected into the app, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-builder database provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a database provisioned and wired into my app without leaving the builder

citations.quote: Available integrations include databases like Upstash for Redis and Neon for Serverless Postgres, backend services like Supabase, and AI model providers.
v0 plans, creates tasks, and connects to databases as it builds.
One Project shares deployment, hosting, domains, and environment variables for the chats connected to it.
